scope: Korean B2 offline text and personal-study transfer tasks. Native-human, device and audio review remain separate.

initialFindings: Later dialogue answers and decisions in early teaching examples; several transfer prompts had essentially already been answered.
Club consultation and the garden agreement needed an actual decision. Some distractors fit the dialogue, and the trade construction needed learner production.
wholePathReview.recheck: All ten early models use the opening learner turn. L6 distinguishes a quick vote from a longer consultation. The second household accepts the size and watering rota in L10. The reviewer reconstructed the final field edits and verified new facts are needed for the transfer tasks.
remaining: Before enabling typed grading, support 2시간이면 as an alternative to 두 시간이면 in L2, or render that slot as a closed choice. The offline reader does not grade typed answers.

postReviewCopyCheck.reviewer: Fresh read-only Codex reviewer for the final copy and answer presentation changes
postReviewCopyCheck.scope: Verified the five final source files against the complete reviewed versions. Reversing all eight field edits in memory reproduced all five whole-file review hashes. The four time choices have exactly one answer grounded in the 9–11 lift booking. The closing Korean, English and German summaries each express both outcomes in one sentence. All five final source and assessment hashes matched; no material findings.

lessonsRead.reason: propose→counteroffer→invite coherent; them4 reveals Friday block + silent Minji and learner answers both (점심으로 바꾸죠 + direct invite). 아직 말씀 안 하신 분은 어떻게 생각하세요? only modelled in pattern example 2, acceptable since Minji is named. Synthesis blank 답 주시면 rejects natural 답을 주시면.

Lift window and 10:00 truck chained correctly into summarize turn; 승강기 trophy fits booking context. Build distractor 몇 층까지 slots grammatically into the practised sentence (승강기를 몇 층까지 쓸 수 있는지). DE/EN of turn 3 drop 가구부터 'first' (optional).

Absence and added demo both answered; learner takes demo and trades draft review. 대신 as bare connector in L3 synthesis is pre-B2 lexis, not new grammar. Decoy 최종본을 is pinned wrong by 우선 and later 초안 검토.

First learner-subject -(으)ㄹ 테니까 correctly staged here with a distinct-agent request. Architecture's verb-attached -는 대신(에) (trade) never appears in any learner turn across L4–6; only sentence-initial 대신 (L3, L9) occurs.
Weather trigger and equipment cap handled separately; staggered groups of ten match architecture. 관리소예요 as chat self-identification is abrupt (optional 관리소인데요). Cloze rejects natural 옮기는 걸로 하죠.

-(으)ㄹ 바에는 … 게 낫겠어요 natural; stance kept then conceded (간식비). DE pattern rule claims a follow-up question to the group that the EN rule and example do not contain. Cloze 그래도 rejects 하지만/그렇지만, both natural in context.

-되 …쪽으로 정리할게요 introduced (dialogue + example 2); overrun offset vs rental drop logic sound; driving assigned in turn 3. Synthesis 못 아끼면 rejects 아끼지 못하면. (P9/P10 checks in brief not applicable to this path; P7 floor chunks correctly sit in L8–9 them turns.)

말씀 중에 죄송한데요 modelled in them turn with genuine new information (director 10 min); 한계예요/나머지는 staged. you1 DE 'lade sie hoch' / EN 'post them' mistranslate 정리해서 올릴게요 (submit to manager). Synthesis rejects 지금까지 정리하면.

끝까지 들어 주시겠어요? modelled and followed by the system-check reveal; -는 걸로 해 주시겠어요? staged with concrete trade. Build distractor 영구히 form-fits in place of 잠깐. DE 'Hören Sie mich bitte zu Ende an?' is not idiomatic as a question.

Three-point summary with owner-first clauses; them 해요체 only (no 합쇼체) consistent with non-extended variant. Synthesis blank 정리하면 rejects the architecture's own 지금까지 정리하면. 세대가 열 곳 is a slightly off counter (optional).

findings.issue: Architecture lists verb-attached -는 대신(에) as productive in L4-6, but no learner turn uses it (only bare connector 대신 in L3/L9). Architecture L4 example itself uses 하는 대신.

findings.fix: Add '답을 주시면' and '답해 주시면'.

findings.issue: Long-negation variant 아끼지 못하면 rejected though fully natural in context.
findings.fix: Add '아끼지 못하면'.

findings.issue: 정리해서 올릴게요 (submit upward to the manager) mistranslated as 'lade sie hoch' / 'post them'.

Apply identically to pattern.examples[0].base and trophy.example.base (same text).

findings.issue: Same as L8: 지금까지 정리하면 (architecture target form) rejected.
findings.fix: Add '지금까지 정리하면'.

findings.issue: 몇 층까지 slots into the practised sentence in place of 몇 시부터 with a plausible reading (승강기를 몇 층까지 쓸 수 있는지).
findings.fix: Replace '몇 층까지' with '탔는데' (cannot precede 확인하고 in this sentence).

findings.issue: 영구히 form-fits in place of 잠깐 (양보는 영구히 미뤄 두고 …).

findings.fix: de: 'Bringen wir um neun zuerst die Möbel runter …'; en: 'Let's bring the furniture down first at nine …'. Also pattern/trophy not affected (turn 3 not reused).

findings.fix: '관리소인데요. 장비는 장갑 열 켤레하고 집게 열 개가 전부예요. 더 사기는 어려워요.' (base unchanged).

findings.issue: 세대가 열 곳 uses place counter for households; 열 세대/열 가구 is the standard count.

lessonsRead.reason: Propose→counteroffer→invite intact; them2 budget and them4 (two can't Friday + Minji silent) both delayed and both answered in turn 5 (점심으로 바꾸죠 / direct address to 민지 씨 / 삼십만 원 안에서). Prior finding 답을 주시면 now accepted. Remaining unfairness: cloze blank1 rejects 확인한 후에, the most standard equivalent of 확인한 다음에.

Lift window 9–11 and truck at 10 drive a coherent sequence; turn 5 summary assigns 가구/박스/싣기 to the three people. 가구부터 now rendered 'zuerst/first'. 몇 층까지 decoy replaced. Synthesis blank1 rejects 싣기로 하죠 although L5 accepts both 하죠/해요 for the same frame; cloze blank1 rejects 맡아 주실 수 있을까요 which L9 accepts for the parallel frame.

Absence in week 3 answered by 휴가 전에 끝낼 수 있는 부분부터; demo taken with a real trade (시연은 제가 맡을게요. 대신 초안 검토는 현우 씨가). Decoys 혼자서만/미뤘어요 contradict 두 분이 and verb slot. Synthesis blank0 rejects 제가 할게요, fully natural before 시연은.

-(으)ㄹ 테니까 first productive on learner subject (제가 조용히 할 테니까) and -는 대신 now present in turn 5 with carrierTag; prior missing-carrier finding resolved. Note the realised sense is 'instead of' (나누지 말고 accepted), while the architecture labels the carrier as trade; the trade itself is carried by 할 테니까 … 줄여 주시겠어요. Acceptable, flagged optional.

Weather fallback (비가 오면 일요일 아침으로 바로 옮기기로 하죠) and ten-tool cap (조별로 열 명씩 시간대를 나누죠, 다음 조에 참여) both respond to the delayed constraints without discouraging. 옮기는 걸로 하죠 and 관리소인데요 fixed. Cloze blank0 still rejects 어쩔 수 없으니.

-(으)ㄹ 바에는 … 게 낫겠어요 counteroffer, concession on 간식비 with 온라인 연습 to answer newcomers' weekly need, conclude with chat vote by tomorrow and venue answer 모레 fits 'this week'. DE rule now equivalent to EN; 하지만/그렇지만 accepted. Synthesis blank1 rejects 주는 걸로 하죠 / 주기로 하죠.
No-licence constraint answered by 운전은 제가 할 테니까; 20% overrun answered conditionally with -되 (기차로 가되 … 못 아끼면 버스로) and lodging delegated to 두 분. 아끼지 못하면 now accepted. Decoys 주차한/혼자만 non-fitting.

Invite (순서대로 정리해서 올릴게요 now 'lege sie Ihnen vor'/'send them through to you'), 한계예요 + 쪽으로 정리하면 어떨까요, then 말씀 중에 죄송한데요 modelled in them4 (assistant, well motivated) and front-loading of the director's item. 지금까지 정리하면 accepted.

Both floor chunks verified receptively: 끝까지 들어 주시겠어요? in them2 (DE now 'Würden Sie mich bitte zu Ende anhören?'). 영구히 decoy replaced by 취소했으니. Concede with 대신 … 쓰는 걸로 해 주시겠어요? gives the concrete next-week trade. Them2's floor-claim is only weakly motivated since the learner did not interrupt (optional).

Three-point summary (정리하면 세 가지예요) only after household a agrees (열 세대도 좋아요 / 물 당번도 그렇게 하죠) and the one-page-by-Friday constraint; office refusal of watering answered by rotating 세대 duty. 열 곳 replaced by 열 가구; 지금까지 정리하면 accepted. All them turns haeyo as permitted.

languageVerdict.reason: L2 cloze blank 0 choices contain exactly one contextually correct option. Given 승강기는 아홉 시부터 두 시간만 예약돼 있어요, only 두 시간이면 빠듯하니까 ('two hours is tight') is correct. 두 시까지 and 두 시부터 refer to two o'clock, which contradicts the 9–11 booking and does not work as the subject of 빠듯하다; 두 시간마다 ('every two hours') is semantically wrong. None of the distractors overlap acceptedAnswers.
